:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.12`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useFlatMathMinMax`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/prefer-flat-math-min-max`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-flat-math-min-max.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useFlatMathMinMax": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Prefer flat `Math.min()` and `Math.max()` calls over nested calls of the same method.

`Math.min()` and `Math.max()` accept any number of arguments, so nesting the same call is unnecessary.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
const biggest = Math.max(Math.max(a, b), c);
```

### Valid

```js
const biggest = Math.max(a, b, c);
const clamped = Math.max(Math.min(value, upper), lower);
```
